main_text.p: 16.19. &c. Corinthij se inuicem, 2 Cor. 13.12. sancti Philip. pe-, ses, Phil. 4.21. &c. Aristarchus, Marcus, &c. Colossenses, Col. 4.v. 10. &c. Eubulus, &c. Timotheum 2 Tim. 4.v.21. Pauli comites Titum, Tit. 3.15. Epaphras, &c. Philemonem, Philem.v.23. Hebræi suos præpositos, Hebr. 13.24. & Itali Hebræos, ibid. Ecclesia Babylone collecta sanctos 1 Pe. 5.13. Amici Caij, Caium, 3 Ioan. v.15.

Salutandi superiores ritus: Exempla: Abraham, Gen. 23. 7 Ruth, Ruth. 2.10. Abigail, 1 Sam. 25.v 23.24. Miphibosheth, 2 Sam. 9.6. Iob. 14.22. Absalom, veri 33. Bethsabee, 1 Reg. 1.16. Filij prophetarum. 2 Reg. 2.15. Salutationes in foro amabant Pharisæi & Scribæ, Matth 23.7. Luc. 20.46.

[SALVVS dicitur, qui à Deo immediatè vel mediatè ex variis periculis recipitur: Genesios, 19 17. Iudic. 6 36. 2 Sam. 19.5. & 22. versic. 4. 28. 2 Reg. 16. 6. & 19. 19. Iob. 5. 15. Psalm. 3. 8. & 6. 5. & 7. versic. 2, 3. 11. & sæpissimè aliis sequentibus, Matth. 14.30. & 27.42. Act. 23. 24. & 27 31. 1 Petr. 3.20.]

[Saluus, liberatus à peccatis, & vitæ æternæ in hac vita per fidem & spem, post hanc vitam re ipsa particeps: Matthæi, 1.21. Marc. 16. 16. Lucæ. 8. 2. Ioan. 5.34. Actorum 2 v.21.47. & 4.12. & 11.14. & 14 9. & 16.30.31. Roman. 5.v.9.10 & 8.23. & 9.27. & 10 v.9.13. & 11.v.4.26 1 Cor. 1.v. 18.21. 2 Cor. 2,15.1. Thess. 2.16 2 Thess. 1,10.1. Tim. 1.15. & 2.4. & 4.16. 2 Tim. 4.18. Tit. 3.4.]

SAMARIA, quæ postea metropolis fuit decem tribuum Israel, extruitur, 1 Regum 16. 24. obsidetur à Syris, 2 Reg 6 24. obsidetur ab Assyrus vique in tertium annum, capitur, abducitur populus, & habitatur ab extraneis 17. 5.24. samaria quando capta ab Assyriis, v.6. &c. & 18.v.9. o samaria nolebat recipere verbum Dei. Luc. 9.53. recipit illud, Actor. 8.5. (1 Custodia Domini).

SAMARIAE excidium prædicitur, Esa. 7.9. & 9.7.8. Ezech. 23. &c. Oe. 14.1 Amos. 3.2. Mich. 1.6. samariæ idololatria, zech. 23.v. 4. 5. iniquitas, Amos 3.9. Mich. 1.3. samariæ mala. Ose. 13.16. & 14. v. 1. &c. samariæ mons emtus ab Gimri rege Israel, 1 Reg. 16,24.
SAMARITANAE historia, Ioannis 4. 7. &c. Vide Mulier samaritana. samaritanis Christū prædicat Philippus, Act. 8.5.

page.notes: Page is a dense index page, one column, with the left edge cut off so some line beginnings are lost; uncertain readings include "Gimri" (probably Zimri) and "Mulier" line cut at the margin, and "Ioan. 4" line lacks clear punctuation. Printed text is transcribed as legible; word-initial letters at the cut edge are partly missing.
